text: The sexton stood. <break time="0.8s" /> In the porch of the Milford meeting house. <break time="0.8s" /> Pulling busily at the bell rope. <break time="0.8s" /> While the old people of the village. <break time="0.8s" /> Came stooping along the street. <break time="0.8s" /> But what has good Parson Hooper. <break time="0.8s" /> Got upon his face. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried the sexton in astonishment. <break time="0.8s" /> As the minister came slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> Along the street toward the meeting house. <break time="0.8s" /> Mister Hooper. <break time="0.8s" /> A gentlemanly man of about thirty. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was still a bachelor. <break time="0.8s" /> Was dressed neatly. <break time="0.8s" /> But there was one thing remarkable. <break time="0.8s" /> In his appearance. <break time="0.8s" /> Swathed about his forehead. <break time="0.8s" /> And hanging down over his face. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a black veil. <break time="0.8s" /> Which entirely concealed his features. <break time="0.8s" /> Except the mouth and chin. <break time="0.8s" /> Our parson has gone mad. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Goodman Gray. <break time="0.8s" /> And a strange murmur spread. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the meeting house. <break time="0.8s" /> As the veiled minister walked slowly. <break time="0.8s" /> Up the aisle. <break time="0.8s" /> Many people turned around. <break time="0.8s" /> In their seats to stare. <break time="0.8s" /> And several little boys. <break time="0.8s" /> Climbed upon the benches. <break time="0.8s" /> And came down again. <break time="0.8s" /> With a terrible racket. <break time="0.8s" /> That day he preached. <break time="0.8s" /> About secret sin. <break time="0.8s" /> About the sad mysteries. <break time="0.8s" /> Which we hide. <break time="0.8s" /> From our nearest and dearest. <break time="0.8s" /> And even from our own consciousness. <break time="0.8s" /> Each member of the congregation. <break time="0.8s" /> Even the most innocent girl. <break time="0.8s" /> Felt as if the preacher had crept upon them. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind his awful veil. <break time="0.8s" /> And discovered their hidden sins.
